display-name: SAP S/4HANA Debit Memo Request API
description: The SAP S/4HANA Sales connector provides APIs that enable seamless integration with the [Debit Memo Request (A2X) API v1.0.0](https://api.sap.com/api/API_DEBIT_MEMO_REQUEST_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update, and delete debit memo requests, including their items, partners, pricing elements, and texts.
key-features: Create, read, update, and delete debit memo requests in SAP S/4HANA
Seamless integration with the Debit Memo Request (A2X) API v1.0.0
Support for basic and OAuth 2.0 authentication
Operations for debit memo request items, partners, pricing elements, texts, and subsequent process flows
